title: Anti Ghost in Client
description: Check if there are ghost blocks in the 9 × 9 × 9 access of the Minecraft client centered around the player's location and eliminate them. 检查Minecraft客户端以玩家所在位置为中心的9×9×9访问内是否存在幽灵方块并消除。
body:
检查Minecraft客户端以所指位置的9×9×9访问内是否存在幽灵方块并消除。

使用 U 键或 /ghost 以使用其功能。

另外说明的是：本模组针对的是理应不存在（即服务端不存在且正常逻辑下也不应该存在）却出现在客户端的方块，与已有的一个反幽灵方块的模组所适用的情况不同。

必须在服务端和客户端安装！若仅在任意一段安装将是功能无法使用！

Check if there are ghost blocks in the Minecraft client's 9x9x9 access at the specified location and eliminate them.

Use the U key or /ghost to access its functions.

Additionally, it should be noted that this module is designed for blocks that should not exist (i.e., should not exist on the server and should not exist under normal logic) but appear on the client side, which is different from the situation where an existing anti ghost block module is applicable.

Must be installed on both the server and client! Installing on only one side will render it useless.

By Caelus Aether
